title: data/topalbums.json
description: Most played albums over a recent window, for the record crate on music.html (js/albums.js). Written weekly by .github/scripts/refresh_now.py from Last.fm's user.gettopalbums; left as it was when that fetch fails.

albums.description: Most played first, at most 24. Albums Last.fm has no sleeve art for are left out, since the crate is made of sleeves.

url.description: The album's Last.fm page; each sleeve links to it.

img.description: Sleeve art, hotlinked from Last.fm's image host (the extralarge size, else large).

period.description: The Last.fm period the ranking covers.

updated.description: Date of the refresh that wrote the file, YYYY-MM-DD.
